    AI Overview
    The Artemis II splashdown lands on Friday, April 10, 2026, with coverage starting around 6:30 p.m. ET (5:30 p.m. CT). The primary, free viewing option is the NASA YouTube channel or NASA+ streaming. Major news networks (ABC, NBC) and services like Peacock, Prime Video, and Netflix are also covering it. 
    Key Streaming/Channel Options: 
    • NASA Live: NASA+, YouTube, and the NASA app.
    • Streaming Services: Netflix, Peacock, Prime Video, Apple TV, HBO Max, Discovery+, Roku.
    • News: ABC News Live, NBC News Now.
    • Splashdown Location: Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, CA.
    • Estimated Time: Approx. 8:07 p.m. ET (5:07 p.m. PT).
